name: YouTube Media & Stream Downloader
author: Zyntra Community
description: Adds 1-tap download buttons and stream quality variant grabber to YouTube mobile and desktop watch pages.
fullDescription: Seamlessly integrates directly with YouTube watch pages to intercept live media streams and inject direct 1-tap downloading into Zyntra multi-threaded transfer engine.

name: Forced OLED Dark Mode
author: Zyntra Community
description: Forces clean dark mode on bright websites with high-contrast text and inversion shielding.
fullDescription: Custom CSS injection engine designed specifically for OLED mobile displays. Reduces eye strain and conserves battery life without breaking web layout structure.

name: HTML5 Video Speed Master
author: HyperStream Devs
description: Floating speed controller overlay offering 0.25x to 4.0x fine-grained playback speed on all video players.
fullDescription: Injects intuitive gesture & button controls over any HTML5 video tag across the web. Speed up lectures, tutorials, podcasts, and streams up to 4x.

name: Anti-Modal & Clean Reader
author: OpenWeb Collective
description: Removes annoying newsletter popups, backdrop overlays, and reading blockers.
fullDescription: Restores the web reading experience by automatically discarding blocking full-screen popups, newsletter signup modals, and restoring disabled scrolling.

name: Hi-Res Image Saver & Zoomer
author: PixelForge
description: Long-press any web image to view full resolution source and save directly to Zyntra Vault.
fullDescription: Extracts full-resolution uncompressed image targets behind thumbnails on social sites and web galleries, allowing 1-tap download into Zyntra Vault.

name: Reading Ruler & Focus Mode
author: FocusLab
description: Follows your touch or finger with a highlighted reading strip to enhance text comprehension.
fullDescription: A guided reading aid that isolates paragraphs and lines on long articles, reducing cognitive overload and visual distractions.

name: Kinetic Smooth Scrolling
author: FlowMotion
description: Applies fluid kinetic deceleration scrolling to all websites with zero frame drops.
fullDescription: Overrides stuttery native scroll momentum curves with a fluid 60/120fps kinetic physics model.
